record.paper_title: Exchange Bias and Interface-related Effects in Two-dimensional van der Waals Magnetic Heterostructures: Open Questions and Perspectives
record.original_question: In ferromagnet/antiferromagnet van der Waals heterostructures, what is the exact coupling mechanism between spins at the ferromagnetic/antiferromagnetic interface that produces exchange bias?

evidence.quote: i. What is the exact coupling mechanism between spins at the FM/AFM interface in FM/AFM vdW systems?

artifact.category_tag: van der Waals magnetic heterostructures / exchange bias
artifact.status_search_result: Recent reviews and experimental studies on van der Waals magnetic heterostructures (e.g., CrI3, Fe3GeTe2/MnPS3, Fe3GeTe2/FePS3, CrCl3-based systems) consistently identify the precise interfacial coupling mechanism producing exchange bias as an open question. While candidate mechanisms (uncompensated interfacial spins, proximity-induced exchange, DMI, superexchange) are discussed, no consensus microscopic model has been established as of 2026.

status_evidence.title: Exchange Bias in van der Waals Heterostructures (review)
status_evidence.snippet: Lists as an open question: 'What is the exact coupling mechanism between spins at the FM/AFM interface in FM/AFM vdW systems?'
status_evidence.claim: The exact interfacial coupling mechanism is explicitly listed as an unresolved open question.
